## Checklist

- [ ] The title starts with a type (`fix:`, `feat:`, …)
- [ ] `npm run check`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] I did not change a version number by hand (the release bot does that)
- [ ] I did not commit a secret or an API key
